name: Number Firewall — no digit without a parent
one_liner: Generalise the one deterministic number gate from the overview narrative to every agent turn and brief: each numeric token is sourced (matches a tool-result leaf), derived (one binary op over two sourced leaves, formula shown) or orphan (struck with a chip), at zero tokens and with rupee/crore/lakh awareness.
rides_on: sidecar/services/company_narrative.py:209-248 (_verify_text; only call sites :487,:491, sole route caller sidecar/routers/fundamentals.py:168)
sidecar/services/agent_runtime.py:1571-1587 (every tool result already held as a role=tool message in the loop)
sidecar/services/research/citecheck.py:40,43 (the LLM spot-audit it supersedes: 8 claims, needs 15 s wall)
new_parts: ₹ / Rs / crore / lakh / Cr / L / mn scale tokens + Indian digit grouping (1,05,130) in the number regex, with a parity vector file
derivation search (a/b, a-b, (a-b)/b, a*b, CAGR) over sourced leaves under a leaf cap
number_receipts array on the final stream event
hover/strike renderer in chat and brief prose; 'from model memory' label for turns with no tool calls
risk: False orphans on legitimate multi-step model arithmetic train users to ignore the strike; mitigated by the no-tool-turn 'model memory' label and recognised derivations.

name: Evidence Locker — the filing you relied on, hashed and kept
one_liner: Persist the page text the run already verifies against (today an in-memory dict discarded at run end) with sha256, fetch time and page number, so every citation opens offline from disk and a silently revised exchange filing is detected and diffed.
rides_on: sidecar/services/research/deep.py:331-354 (_Findings.evidence raw-evidence store, in-memory for the run)
sidecar/services/search/extract.py:506 (pages_used computed) and :517-518 (page identity flattened away)
sidecar/services/runs_store.py:55 (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS store precedent)
new_parts: evidence_locker SQLite store {sha256, url, fetched_at, page_no, zlib text}; LRU cap with pinning for rows cited by a saved brief/claim/tripwire/promise
extract_pdf_text returns [(page_no, paragraph)]
optional locker:{sha256,page} on BriefSource (additive, not the plugin contract)
filing_revised event + page-text diff on hash mismatch; 're-verify' action
risk: Scanned Indian filings have no text layer, so the locker holds only a hash plus an honest image-only marker and the receipt is weaker; no OCR in v1.

name: Claim Checker — paste anyone's number, get a verdict
one_liner: Point the ULTRA extract/re-check/verdict shape at foreign text (a tweet, a broker note, another AI's answer) and at the structured witnesses instead of the web: MATCHES / CONTRADICTED / DIFFERENT BASIS / STALE / CANNOT CHECK, exposed as one catalog capability that auto-projects to MCP so Claude Desktop or Cursor can use Vysted as a fact-checker.
rides_on: sidecar/services/research/verify.py:1-16 (ULTRA cross-check: own briefs vs fresh web only)
new_parts: check_claims read_handler capability + handler
one small LLM binding call {symbol, metric enum, period} with a code-enforced verbatim-substring rule (the model labels, never introduces a number)
verdict card; keyless manual-binding path
risk: Period binding errors (TTM vs FY vs MRQ) produce confident false CONTRADICTED; an unbound period must downgrade to CANNOT CHECK.

name: The Scoreboard — the app measures its own wrongness
one_liner: Append every witness conflict to a local ledger so the agent can answer 'how far should I trust your market cap on SME names' from its own measured history, and ship a zero-LLM `pnpm trust-bench` that diffs the 24-name hostile battery against outside-truth packs into a committed TRUST.md with the failures left in.

new_parts: conflict_ledger SQLite table {ts, symbol, segment, field, provider, provider_value, witness, witness_value, kind}, age-bounded
aggregate line in the terminal preamble + Settings → Trust table

risk: Outside-truth packs age (quarterly agent refresh is the keep-alive cost) and publishing your own failures hands rivals marketing copy.

name: Tripwires — kill-criteria compiled to code, zero tokens while watching
one_liner: The agent compiles the user's written exit conditions into predicates in the existing no-eval screener grammar, the user approves them in the diff gate, and a deterministic keyless sidecar loop fires an OS notification with the filing page when one trips — the model is never in the watch loop because the BYOK key is unavailable unattended by design.
rides_on: sidecar/services/run_manager.py:36-38 (key lives only on the in-memory task closure)
new_parts: event fields in the formula FIELD set (announcement.category, headline match, promoter delta, results.opm)

curated per-event-class synonym table shipped as data
'blind since <ts> on <lane>' status so a dead poller is never silent
risk: Unstandardised NSE/BSE category and headline wording makes text predicates miss ('cessation' vs 'resignation'); needs the synonym table plus Idea 6's unmatched-but-material bucket.

name: Lid-closed honesty — a catch-up that states its own blind spots
one_liner: A sleeping laptop cannot watch, so make reconstruction accountable: on wake, fetch announcements for holdings ∪ watchlist since last_seen_at, prove per-symbol coverage (or page deeper / declare the gap), rank deterministically by category × position weight, and show one card that also lists what it could not see.
new_parts: last_seen_at + announcement seen-ledger, pruned at 180 d
coverage proof (oldest item predates last_seen_at, or fewer than limit returned; else page deeper)
category weight table with a counted-not-listed 'routine' class
'since you were away' card with a blind-spots line
risk: Noise from boilerplate small-cap filings (trading-window closures, newspaper clippings) unless the routine class is tuned.

name: Promise Ledger with the dog that did not bark
one_liner: Management promises stored as verbatim, code-verified quotes pinned to a locker page, resolved KEPT/BROKEN deterministically against results — plus FADED, a pure text search showing a plan that quietly vanished from the last N calls.
rides_on: sidecar/services/research/disclosures.py:4-5,19-22 (transcripts and presentations arrive as attachment_url rows, read by the PDF lane)

promise timeline panel with a transcript-coverage statement ('2 of 8 quarters readable')
risk: Hedged management language makes KEPT/BROKEN a judgement call; auto-resolve only promises with a number and a date, and small-cap transcript coverage is thin or scanned.

name: Forkable research — a brief you can git diff, replay without an LLM, and attach to a bug report
one_liner: A thin versioned bundle (structured legs + execution record + number receipts + locker hashes + tool trace, no secrets) that any other Vysted install can Verify by deterministic replay at zero tokens — one format for sharing, re-verifying your own old work, and the redacted diagnostics bundle.
